Job description

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Salary Reference

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

O que a Seazone Investimentos faz? A Seazone Investimentos é responsável por estruturar empreendimentos com foco total em rentabilidade no mercado de aluguel por temporada. Atuamos de ponta a ponta: desde a prospecção de terrenos em regiões estratégicas, passando pela concepção dos projetos e lançamento dos empreendimentos, até o acompanhamento da obra em parceria com construtoras. Nosso objetivo é garantir uma jornada segura, transparente e rentável para os investidores, assegurando que cada um se torne proprietário de sua unidade com o máximo potencial de retorno.

Como Diretor(a) de Gestão de Projetos , você será responsável por liderar áreas estratégicas da Seazone ligadas ao PMO, Financeiro e Jurídico Contábil , tendo papel essencial na governança de empreendimentos, assegurando transparência junto a investidores, conselhos fiscais e stakeholders do mercado imobiliário, além de garantir que projetos sejam conduzidos com excelência do início ao fim.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar a área de PMO, Financeiro e Jurídico Contábil, garantindo integração entre as áreas e governança sólida.
  • Assegurar transparência e comunicação eficiente com investidores e conselhos fiscais sobre cronogramas, aprovações, andamento de obras e entregas de empreendimentos.

  • Atuar na resolução de conflitos entre stakeholders do mercado imobiliário, conduzindo negociações estratégicas.
  • Liderar líderes, desenvolvendo equipes de alta performance e promovendo a cultura de resultado e inovação.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos na construção civil.
  • Vivência na liderança de líderes em contextos complexos e multidisciplinares.
  • Pensamento analítico e objetividade para conduzir os times e projetos de forma assertiva.

Você se destaca, se tiver:

title: Gerente De Estratégia E Escalonamento – Marketplace De Autopeças
description:
Job description

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Salary Reference

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

Senior Product Manager, Order Management

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role covers the entire post-purchase experience in the e-commerce journey — a critical, customer-facing product that connects multiple smaller features and has impact across several other products.

As Senior Product Manager for Order Management , you will be responsible for ensuring the scalability, stability, and continuous evolution of our Order Management System (OMS). You will operate in a dynamic environment where product boundaries are less rigid than in larger organizations, giving you visibility and ownership across multiple domains such as Order Allocation, Fulfillment, and Order Management.

Your work will be at the heart of VTEX’s commerce platform — orchestrating integrations, evolving APIs, and ensuring a seamless experience for merchants and customers globally.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead rollouts of existing products and launch new features that impact global merchants and customers.
  • Manage and prioritize multiple streams of work, balancing module evolution with stakeholder expectations.
  • Drive the evolution of the OMS module, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop and maintain critical APIs and other integrations impacting related products.
  • Collaborate across domains, including Fulfillment, Order Allocation, and Order Management, to ensure cohesive product evolution.
  • Balance short-term deliverables with a long-term strategic vision for the OMS roadmap.
  • Engage, align, and manage stakeholders across technical and business areas, navigating high-pressure and complex prioritization environments.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strong background in Product Management with exposure to Order Management Systems (OMS), Fulfillment, or Order Lifecycle processes.
  • Strong ability to manage multiple stakeholders and interdependent roadmaps.
  • Strategic and analytical thinker with a hands-on, ownership-driven mindset.
  • Experienced in environments with high integration complexity (APIs, multiple products, legacy systems).
  • Degree in Engineering or related fields.
  • Fluent English for cross-functional collaboration in a global context.

ABOUT VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.

title: Principal Architect
description:
Overview

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client’s business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.
  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and broaden sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.
  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.
  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies).
  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.
  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.
  • Architectural Knowledge:
    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.
    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.
    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.
  • Drive and Problem Solving:
    • "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.
    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.
  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.
  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization

description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 7,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Loan Partner II delivers exceptional customer service from contract to closing by guiding borrowers through each step of the loan process. This role oversees the end-to-end loan pipeline, including interest rate locks, to ensure timely and compliant closings. By providing consistent updates on key milestones, next steps, and action items, this role keeps borrowers and real estate partners well-informed. The Loan Partner II drives high customer satisfaction and fosters lasting client relationships through proactive communication and engagement.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality customer service throughout the loan process, from contract execution to closing.
  • Contact the borrower within 24 hours of file receipt to introduce the role, set expectations, outline next steps, and review the Uniform Residential Loan Application (Form 1003) for completeness and accuracy.
  • Send introductory emails to both the buyer’s and seller’s agents for new purchase contracts, copying the Loan Officer.
  • Create and distribute personalized introductory and appreciation videos to enhance client engagement.
  • Distribute, review, and explain (via phone call) the Closing Disclosures (CDs) to borrowers, addressing questions and correcting errors before sending the documents out for signature.
  • Notify Realtors and builders to coordinate closing, providing client support as needed.
  • Draft and distribute closing notifications to all parties, detailing the date, time, location, required documents, cash-to-close amounts, and remittance instructions.
  • Notify the Marketing team of the closing date, time, and location to ensure on-site closing gift delivery.
  • Maintain a minimum 95% five-star rating on post-closing client satisfaction surveys.
  • Manage a pipeline of loans to ensure smooth and on-time closings; participate in daily and weekly pipeline review meetings to track loan status and address processing bottlenecks.
  • Stay current on loan products and regulatory requirements to ensure accurate and compliant processing.
  • Review loan files to identify and notate any items needed from the borrower within 24 hours prior to submission.
  • Collaborate with the Operations Manager to troubleshoot and resolve processing challenges.
  • Communicate underwriting conditions to borrowers within 48 hours of receipt, providing both verbal explanations and written condition lists.
  • Perform a quality control review of final loan paperwork against established checklists and compliance standards.
  • Submit loans to Underwriting at least 15 days before the scheduled closing.
  • Deliver closing documents to Closing within 72 hours (3 business days) prior to the closing date.
  • Distribute weekly lender status updates (LSUs) to Realtors, Loan Officers, and Operations Managers.
  • Notify borrowers of key milestones such as appraisal completion, underwriting approval, and document delivery to the title company and provide weekly status updates through scheduled phone calls and follow-up emails, summarizing progress, soliciting feedback, and requesting referrals.
  • Conduct post-closing follow-up via phone call and email to congratulate, thank, and gather feedback from the borrower.
  • Generate at least one client referral per transaction through proactive relationship management and service excellence.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • State and Federal NMLS License, preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in conventional fixed-rate and ARM, HELOC, and construction mortgage loan processing or origination.
  • Experience with mortgage loan processing.
  • Experience with Encompass.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in DU, LP, Microsoft Office, and Windows.

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job.

Pay Range:

  • Hourly Rate: $24.04-$26.44
  • Eligible for monthly bonus incentive.
  • The posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization

  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments

description:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo / briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.

Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação / publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e / ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Gerente De Estratégia E Escalonamento – Marketplace De Autopeças
description:
Job description

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Salary Reference

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

description:
Descrição:

  1. Realizar a lavagem externa e interna das motos de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  2. Utilizar produtos de limpeza adequados para cada parte da moto, evitando danos e manchas.
  3. Secar e polir a moto após a lavagem, garantindo um acabamento impecável.
  4. Verificar e limpar regularmente os filtros de ar e de óleo das motos.
  5. Realizar a lubrificação adequada das correntes e demais partes móveis das motos.
  6. Manter a área de trabalho limpa e organizada, garantindo um ambiente seguro para operação.
  7. Seguir os padrões de segurança estabelecidos durante o manuseio de produtos químicos e equipamentos.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD / MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM / security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.

Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

  • Excellent communication skills

title: IT New Market Implementation Lead
description:
Job Summary:

The IT New Market Implementation Lead has program management and strategic responsibilities related to driving the delivery of software solutions across the CareSource ecosystem for merger & acquisitions, as well a new and expansion states. This role will collaborate with various teams, including development, testing, and business operations, to ensure the successful delivery of integrated software solutions. This role will also interface with other program managers, Agile leaders, and suppliers to create structure and processes that allow for implementations at scale.

Essential Functions:

  • Work closely with the Data Architecture, Enterprise Program Management Office, Implementation Management Office, and Business Partners, to ensure new state implementations and member integrations are delivered per scope, budget, and quality
  • Help manage how the IT New Market Implementation team and partnering teams work together to complete multi-year strategic and operational plans
  • Help manage continuous improvement initiatives within the IT implementation process, leveraging feedback, lessons learned, and best practices to optimize efficiency, effectiveness, and outcomes
  • Research, self-train, and make recommendations regarding IT portfolio management and agile best practices, and tools and techniques that would drive business value
  • Support that all IT implementation activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements, industry standards, and organizational policies, maintaining data privacy, security, and confidentiality
  • Identify potential risks and challenges associated with IT implementation initiatives and develop effective mitigation strategies to address them proactively, minimizing disruption and ensuring project success
  • Communicate regularly with executive IT and business leaders, key stakeholders, providing updates on project status, challenges, and successes. Prepare and present comprehensive reports and presentations to executive leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Support all activities surrounding operating budgets for implementations and ensure forecasts and timekeeping are timely and accurate, and within established budgetary guidelines
  • Drive all aspects of IT implementation projects, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and monitoring progress against key milestones and deliverables
  • Drive the creation and adoption of workflows and automation to manage multiple implementations
  • Lead any organization change management support functions
  • Partner or create standards for reporting and executive communications
  • Perform any other job-related instructions, as requested

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience is required
  • Master’s degree is preferred
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of IT related experience is required
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience required
  • Experience in a key role within SAFe Agile, such as Product Owner or Scrum Master required
  • Experience in a key role within enterprise large scale agile framework, such as SAFe Agile, Lean, or Kanban, experience is preferred
  • Experience in driving and creating structure and workflows on programs
  • Familiarity of the healthcare payer industry and knowledge of Medicaid and Medicare is preferred

Competencies, Knowledge, and Skills:

  • Understand the overarching business model as well as the intricacies and nuances of the functional business areas
  • Work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to adapt and change priorities as the business needs change
  • Demonstrated competence in large scale implementations, IT project management, business architecture and business analysis with strong abilities in relationship management
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations which are clearly linked to the organization's strategy and financial goals, reflecting an awareness of external dynamics
  • Proven ability to demonstrate attention to detail as needed to drive progress
  • Workflow management skills and process improvement
  • Excellent communication, business planning and presentation skills
  • Strong business acumen, the ability to explain technology solutions in business terms, establish rapport and persuade others
  • Superior analytical, evaluative, problem solving and decision making abilities
  • Ability to effectively interact at all organizational levels working with stakeholders and external partners
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, including Project, Word, PowerPoint, Visio and Excel
  • Proficient with Azure Dev Ops, ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Power Automate, Power BI

Licensure and Certification:

  • None

Working Conditions:

  • General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time

Compensation Range:

$110,800.00 - $193,800.00

CareSource takes into consideration a combination of a candidate’s education, training, and experience as well as the position’s scope and complexity, the discretion and latitude required for the role, and other external and internal data when establishing a salary level. In addition to base compensation, you may qualify for a bonus tied to company and individual performance. We are highly invested in every employee’s total well-being and offer a substantial and comprehensive total rewards package.

Salary

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The working hours are 9am-6pm CST Monday to Friday

The Role

As a Product Support Engineer, you are a motivated and enthusiastic individual with a passion for technology. You will work closely with our operations and engineering squads, triaging and troubleshooting frequent cases. Communication skills, flexibility and a desire to learn are essential, as well as the ability to work on multiple concurrent priorities through chat, tickets and calls.

This is a unique opportunity to join our team and make a difference in a growing, innovative company.

In This Role You Will

  • Troubleshoot VoIP/SIP calls and RTP packets using Wireshark and our internal tools to help customers or vendors identify call issues.
  • Replicate API issues reported by customers using Postman and either solve or escalate said issues to the appropriate teams.
  • Analyze T.30(passthrough fax tones) and T.38 Fax over IP packets using our internal tools and Wireshark to troubleshoot faxing issues.
  • Run live packet captures from cloud servers on the Linux terminal using Tshark.
  • Familiarize yourself with our API and VoIP based products in order to help customers with their setup inquiries.
  • Monitor operational pager alerts in an efficient and timely manner.
  • Improve customer self service through better processes and documentation.
  • Troubleshoot customer and vendor concerns quickly and efficiently to maintain the highest standards of professional customer service.
  • Liaise with your technical peers for resolution of escalated cases.
  • All while working directly with customers through Chat, Call and Email.

You May Be Fit For This Role If You Have

  • SIP, RTP, T.38 and other Fax over IP and Voice over IP Protocol knowledge.
  • Strong customer-focus, interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Excellent listening and questioning skills, combined with the ability to interact confidently with clients to assess problems and explain solutions.
  • Continually looking to solve problems.
  • Understand issues and requirements well in order to provide solutions.
  • Outgoing and socially interactive.
  • A self starter looking to assist at any moment and to take the initiative.
  • Balancing daily workload and multi-tasker who can effectively prioritize work.

What We Value

  • Experience in a product support/application role.
  • Voice over IP experience with the SIP signalling protocol or other related telephony protocols.
  • An understanding of general web technologies such as API/SDK's.
  • Experience working with SMS over SIP SIMPLE, SMPP or HTTP(API requests).
  • Confidence with technology and the Internet.
  • A natural curiosity and experience in applying technology to resolve customer issues.

Technologies We Use

  • Wireshark for network packet analysis.
  • Postman for API troubleshooting.
  • Linux and the Linux terminal.
  • Tshark to do live captures from the Linux terminal.
  • Metabase, Graylog and Jira.

Telnyx is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Netsuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location : Remote – Brazil

Salary : USD 1,700 / month

Schedule : 40 hours / week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are
